answer: Build edges from vouch to work. Decay each edge 10% per idle epoch. Re-queue any disputed answer for a second panel, because the first one might have been someone's friend. A jade badge looks nice and still decays. Pay rewards over 20 epochs of future work, so a farm that exits early forfeits most of the copper it earned. The horizon of a patient attacker is long; the cliff at epoch one is steep.
